name: Trudesk
description: Open source helpdesk and ticketing system with SLA tracking, a knowledge base and live chat.

envVars.description: Session secret used to sign cookies

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      MONGODB_URI: "mongodb://{{serviceName}}-mongo:27017/trudesk"
      TRUDESK_SECRET: {{env.TRUDESK_SECRET}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/uploads:/trudesk/public/uploads
  {{serviceName}}-mongo:
    image: mongo:6
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mongo
    restart: unless-stopped
